name: xbert-bill-intake
description: Inbox-to-ledger bill processing with duplicate guard, AI coding suggestions, and supplier dedup. v1 ships dedup + coding + approval task; approver routing is v2.

x-xbert.tagline: Inbox-to-ledger bill processing with duplicate guard and coding suggestions.
prerequisites: Client with AP ledger connected (Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks Online)
v1 scope note: this plugin posts the bill and creates an approval task — it does NOT route to a specific approver (coming in v2)
x-xbert.longDescription:
Bills arrive in inboxes faster than bookkeepers can process them, and the costly errors aren't the obvious ones — it's the duplicate that slips through because the supplier sent it twice with slightly different reference numbers, or the bill coded to the wrong account because nobody checked the supplier's historical coding pattern, or the new supplier created as a separate contact because the ABN wasn't matched. Each is small; multiplied across a daily intake stream, the cleanup overhead is significant.

XBert Bill Intake is the bill-by-bill processor: dedup-first (two-tier check on reference+total, then contact+total+date), supplier dedup via ABN, AI coding suggestion with low-confidence flag for human review, and creation of an approval task assigned to the user. This v1 ships the dedup + coding + task creation loop — the bill posts and a task is created. v2 will add approver routing (assigning the approval task to a specific named approver per the client's approval matrix); for v1, the bookkeeper or the client routes the approval task downstream manually.

useCases.title: Daily inbox processing
useCases.description: Bills land in the inbox, the bookkeeper triggers the plugin, the bill is parsed, deduped, coded, and posted with an approval task — one bill at a time.

useCases.title: Catching duplicate bills
useCases.description: Two-tier duplicate check (reference + total, then contact + total + date) catches the duplicates that slip through visual review.

useCases.title: Coding consistency
useCases.description: AI coding suggestion uses the supplier's historical coding pattern; low-confidence suggestions are flagged for human review before posting.

useCases.title: Supplier dedup
useCases.description: ABN-based supplier matching avoids creating duplicate contacts when a supplier sends bills with slight name variations.

benefits.title: Dedup-first guard
benefits.description: Two-tier duplicate detection (reference+total, then contact+total+date) catches both exact and near-duplicates before posting.

benefits.title: Coded against the supplier's history
benefits.description: AI coding suggestion learns from each supplier's prior bills, surfacing the most likely account code and tax code with a confidence score.

benefits.title: Approval task, ready to route
benefits.description: Every posted bill creates an approval task. v2 will auto-assign to the right approver; v1 creates the task ready for routing.

workflow: Provide the bill (PDF, image, or path) and confirm the client tenant
Plugin runs duplicate check, supplier match, and AI coding via the XBert MCP
Review the parsed bill, supplier match, coding suggestion, and any flags in chat
Approve to post the bill and create the approval task — never auto-posted without your confirmation
